title: Round-trip identity — build → get_structure → normalize equals the normalized input
_comment: Seed bootstrap ROUNDTRIP fixture (WP-F06, 14-fixtures-harness.md §7). `input_tree` is built; the fetched tree is normalized with the shared normalizer (packages/server/src/authoring/contract.ts normalize()) which tolerates _cssid injection, empty sibling-key noise, and html-v3 normalization, and compares structurally (not by literal id). `normalized_expected` is what normalize() yields for the input (empty `editor_settings`/`interactions`/`elements` dropped, _cssid stripped). Run as admin so the content-sanitizer title rewrite is exempt (§7, 11-authoring-contract.md §11).
